_auth_note: Uses Azure CLI login (az login) - DefaultAzureCredential
_subscription_instructions: Option 1: Scan ALL subscriptions - Leave both arrays empty: [] []
Option 2: Filter by NAME - Use subscription_names: ['Production', 'Development']
Option 3: Filter by ID - Use subscription_ids: ['xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx']
Option 4: Mix both - Specify both names and IDs (will scan union of both)
Names are case-insensitive and support partial matching
_devops_instructions: 1. Go to Azure DevOps -> User Settings -> Personal Access Tokens
4. Repositories can be strings (uses default branch) or objects with branch selection
_repo_format_note: Repository format: string 'repo-name' OR object {name: 'repo-name', branch: 'branch-name'}. If branch not specified, uses default branch.
_git_repos_manual: Or manually specify full URLs (overrides azure_devops config)
